pairs: The burden of the valley of vision.
What does it mean to you,
that each of you have even climbed to the rooftops?
your dead have not been slain by the sword,
nor did they die in battle.
Cuncti principes tui fugerunt simul dureque ligati sunt;
All your leaders have fled together, and they have been bound by hardship.
omnes qui inventi sunt vincti sunt pariter; procul fugerunt.
All who were found were chained together. They have fled far away.
nolite incumbere ut consolemini me super vastitate filiæ populi mei;
Make no attempt to console me, over the devastation of the daughter of my people.”
For it is a day of death,
and of weeping to the Lord,
and the magnificence above the mountain.
And Elam took up the quiver
and the chariot of the horseman;
and he stripped the wall of the shield.
Et erunt electæ valles tuæ plenæ quadrigarum,
And your elect valleys will be filled with chariots,
et equites ponent sedes suas in porta.
and the horsemen will position themselves at the gates.
And the covering of Judah will be exposed,
et videbis in die illa armamentarium domus saltus.
and in that day, you will see the weaponry of the forest house.
And you will see breaches in the city of David,
But you have gathered together the waters of the lower fish-pool.
And you have numbered the houses of Jerusalem.
et destruxistis domos ad muniendum murum.
And you have destroyed the houses in order to fortify the wall.
Et lacum fecistis inter duos muros ad aquam piscinæ veteris;
And you have made a pit between two walls for the waters of the ancient fish-pool.
et non suspexistis ad eum qui fecerat eam,
But you have not gazed upward to him who made it,
et operatorem ejus de longe non vidistis.
and you have not considered, even from a distance, its Maker.
Et vocabit Dominus Deus exercituum in die illa ad fletum,
And in that day, the Lord, the God of hosts,
will call to weeping and mourning,
to baldness and the wearing of sackcloth.
the killing of calves and the slaughter of rams,
the eating of meat and the drinking of wine:
Et revelata est in auribus meis vox Domini exercituum:
And the voice of the Lord of hosts was revealed in my ears:
Si dimittetur iniquitas hæc vobis donec moriamini,
“Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you, until you die,”
says the Lord, the God of hosts.
ingredere ad eum qui habitat in tabernaculo,
Go forth and enter to him who lives in the tabernacle,
who is in charge of the temple,
and you shall say to him:
or who are you claiming to be here?
For you have hewn a sepulcher for yourself here.
You have diligently hewn a memorial in a rock,
Behold, the Lord will cause you to be carried away,
He will crown you with a crown of tribulation.
quasi pilam mittet te in terram latam et spatiosam;
He will toss you like a ball into a broad and spacious land.
et ibi erit currus gloriæ tuæ,
and there the chariot of your glory will be,
for it is a shame to the house of your Lord.”
Et expellam te de statione tua,
And I will expel you from your station,
et de ministerio tuo deponam te.
and I will depose you from your ministry.
And this shall be in that day:
I will call my servant Eliakim,
And I will clothe him with your vestment,
and I will strengthen him with your belt,
et potestatem tuam dabo in manu ejus;
and I will give your authority to his hand.
et erit quasi pater habitantibus Jerusalem et domui Juda.
And he shall be like a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
Et dabo clavem domus David super humerum ejus;
And I will place the key of the house of David upon his shoulder.
Et figam illum paxillum in loco fideli,
And I will fasten him like a peg in a trustworthy place.
et erit in solium gloriæ domui patris ejus.
And he will be upon a throne of glory in the house of his father.
Et suspendent super eum omnem gloriam domus patris ejus;
And they will suspend over him all the glory of his father’s house:
a vasis craterarum usque ad omne vas musicorum.
from the vessels of bowls even to every instrument of music.
In die illa, dicit Dominus exercituum,
In that day, says the Lord of hosts,
auferetur paxillus qui fixus fuerat in loco fideli,
the peg which was fastened in a trustworthy place shall be taken away. And he will be broken,
et cadet, et peribit quod pependerat in eo,
and he will perish, along with all that had depended upon him,
because the Lord has spoken it.
